critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1076 lines - still recommend splitting into routers (auth/users/leads/files/processors/reports) as flagged in prior iterations.

GET /api/files/report loads up to 5000 lead docs and computes stats in Python. This is fine for current scale but should move to a MongoDB aggregation pipeline before production scale (>10k FILE leads).

PATCH /api/leads/{id}/processor field naming is inconsistent with the review's stated schema: server uses assigned_processor_id / assigned_processor_name (matching assigned_partner_id convention), while the request spec informally referenced processor_id/processor_name. The current names are actually more consistent with the codebase - keep as-is but document in API notes.
FileReports.jsx uses <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere; consider unifying for design consistency (minor).

DELETE /api/users/{id} soft-delete correctly clears sessions and excludes from list_users, but a 'restore' endpoint is missing - if an admin deletes a user by mistake, the only recovery is a direct DB write. Consider a PATCH /users/{id}/restore or including deleted users in list with an 'undelete' action.
Partner-view read-only processor name is shown as plain text; consider a visual chip/badge matching the assigned-partner display for parity.
